description.value: Flames Pizza is a fast-food pizza restaurant in Hope, BC, with a notably eclectic menu that blends classic Canadian pizza styles with South Asian-inspired options such as Butter Chicken Pizza, Tandoori Chicken Pizza, and Paneer Veggie Pizza. Beyond pizza the kitchen turns out pasta, curry dishes, samosas, and ribs, making it a substantial fuel stop for cyclists passing through this Fraser Valley gateway town. Walk-in and online ordering with delivery are both available.
